snippet.title: Gothic 1 Remake | Accolades Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome back to the Colony.

With praise from around the world, Gothic 1 Remake brings back one of the most beloved cult RPGs for a new generation of players.

Gothic 1 Remake is available now on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.
